text:
devin: Heads-up — running a microburst runbook exercise for the weekend marketing drop. Need quick alignment on provisioning, fallback, and cost guardrails. Anyone free for a 15m sync? :rocket:
aj: Free now, what are the target QPS and p99 targets?
devin: Baseline expected global traffic ~1.2k QPS. Microburst scenario: short windows (6–12m) up to ~6.5k QPS. SLOs: p95 <200ms, p99 <600ms. Yesterday's sim output below.
devin: ```
Scenario: weekend-market-drop-microburst
- sustained: 1.2k QPS
- spike: 6.5k QPS for 6m
- model mix: 60% hosted API (latency sensitive), 40% dedicated (batchy rerank)
Estimated infra impact:
- EU reserved: add 10 A100-equivalent GPUs (pre-warm) -> ~420 GPU-hours over 48h window
- APAC on-demand: 4 A100s for peak windows -> ~80 GPU-hours
Fallback policy: route traffic to EU if APAC pool >85% util or NVLINK saturation detected
Notes: current autoscale cooldown ~240s; microbursts borderline for reactive scaling
```
maria: APAC pool already 78% committed that weekend from other campaigns. Buying more on-demand in APAC is expensive — rough back-of-envelope: +8 A100s ~ $12k/day. Could we bias pre-warm to EU and route more traffic cross-region?
leo: Two levers to reduce infra delta: (1) prefix/KV caching to cut token compute (~30–40% effective on chat-heavy flows), (2) temporary quantized model variant for tails. If we warm KV and push cached completions for common templates, that removes a huge chunk of token work.
ops-jen: Important: autoscale cooldown = 4m is too slow for 6m spikes. Options: predictive scaling, pre-warm, or temporary policy that shortens cooldown and increases scale-up step. Also check scheduler limits (pods per node).
sre-bot: Alert summary from yesterday's test: p99 spike observed in APAC during 6m window, no OOMs but NVLINK saturation on node gpux-23; RX/TX per NIC nearing 90%.
ellie: Finance note — APAC on-demand is ~2.1x more expensive than EU reserved when amortized. If we do mix (reserve EU + APAC on-demand for tails) estimated weekend incremental spend ~= $18k. Recommend a hard cap: +15% budget for this campaign unless sales confirm higher ROI.
devin: Proposal (short):
1) Pre-warm EU pool by +10% (reserve temporary capacity) and enable fast-route fallback from APAC -> EU.
2) Deploy KV/prefix warmers (leo) for top 50 prompt templates before window.
3) Apply temporary autoscale policy for sale windows: min nodes +20%, scale-up step +3 nodes, cooldown 75s.
4) Ship quantized model variant toggle (runtime fallback) if p99 > 900ms.
Owners: aj (autoscale infra), leo (caching & warmers), maria (provisioning & procurement), ops-jen (runbook updates).
aj: I'll open a Terraform PR to add the EU reserved nodes and a temporary autoscale override. Expect PR in ~2h.
maria: Booking 4 A100-equivalent on-demand in APAC now to cover immediate tests; submitting procurement for EU reserved add-on. Will keep team posted if procurement stalls.
ops-jen: Updating playbook: new step "manual pre-warm + KV sanity" and an emergency shortcut to route >50% traffic to EU on >3 consecutive 503s. I'll also add a checklist for checking NVLINK and NIC saturation.
devin: Telemetry changes: add a short-term metric microburst_error_budget (percent of requests failing to meet p95/p99) and an alert at 10% breach. Also add cost burn-rate alert at spend +20% over forecast.
sre-bot: Incident stub created: INC-2027-93-microburst-run. Assigned to aj for infra changes.
leo: I'll push KV warmers and a tiny runtime preference patch to prefer cached completions for common prefixes. Running integration now — will report latency numbers in 45m.
ellie: If cost looks like it'll exceed the +15% cap, we should have an approval path: dev->product->finance. I'll prep an approval doc and the expected ROI threshold.
aj: Quick question — do we want to enable model fallback (smaller quantized model) preemptively or only after alerts? Preemptive switch trades quality for latency predictability.
devin: Prefer reactive fallback tied to p99 threshold, with a canary route to 5% traffic to quantized model for validation. If metrics stable, increase to 25% then full.
maria: I'm tagging procurement and platform-sales for urgency. Also will confirm network egress quotas for cross-region routing.
ops-jen: Last step: scheduled dry-run tomorrow at peak hour with full telemetry. I'll schedule the run and post the playbook link.
devin: Thanks all. Quick recap in a follow-up doc and runbook update. :white_check_mark:
